name: Cannalicious | 200mg RSO Rest Gummies | Mixed Berry
description: Finally, an edible with all the benefits of the full cannabis plant! Named after a Canadian medical marijuana activist, Rick Simpson Oil (RSO) is a cannabinoid-rich, broad-spectrum extract that contains all the beneficial plant matter and is the most holistic cannabis concentrate available. These fast-acting Rest RSO Gummies are easy to dose and indica enhanced with a mixed berry flavor that contains a blend of THC, CBD and CBN to promote rest and relaxation and help you fall asleep faster.
